entities.title: Dulmál needs no sign-in
entities.summary: Unlike the other games, Dulmál's Worker does not check icelander.net's sign-in: a shared link or a four-letter code is all a player needs.
entities.context: Every other game's Worker checks icelander.net's sign-in (AGENTS.md, Sign-in). Dulmál is meant for adults who are not gamers, joining from their own phones with one shared link, and the owner asked for no logins and no installs.

options.title: No sign-in; rooms are reached by code
options.consequences: Anyone who has a room's link can join it. Room codes are four letters from 19, about 130,000 codes, and rooms expire after three days idle.

options.title: The site's sign-in, as the other games
options.consequences: Every guest would need a Google or GitHub account and the games: role before they could play.

entities.rationale: The owner's brief: everyone joins with one shared link, no logins, no installs.

entities.title: The game's name
entities.summary: The game is called Dulmál for now; Huldumál and Leyniorð were the other suggestions.
entities.context: The game needed its own Icelandic name, not that of any published game. Changing it means GAME_NAME in src/client/text.ts, the title in public/index.html and, if the address should change too, the route in wrangler.jsonc and BASE in worker/config.ts.

options.title: Dulmál
options.consequences: 'Secret language': plain, short and easy to say.

options.title: Huldumál
options.consequences: 'The hidden people's language': a nod to folklore, a little longer.

options.title: Leyniorð
options.consequences: 'Secret word', or 'password': clear, but also an everyday word for a password.

entities.title: A native speaker's review of the word list and the page's text
entities.summary: The words and phrases listed in LANGUAGE-QA.md were written without a native speaker's check.
entities.context: All player-facing text is Icelandic. LANGUAGE-QA.md lists the words and phrases whose spelling, form or naturalness is least certain.

options.title: Review and correct
options.consequences: Edit data/ord.txt and src/client/text.ts; the tests check the list's form.
